CustomField.label: Expected Value (Formula)
CustomField.description: A Salesforce formula, evaluated on the current record, that produces the value to compare against. Used only when "Expected Value Comes From" is "Record formula". Formula syntax only - not Apex or SOQL. Example: AnnualRevenue / 10.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Salesforce formula giving the value to compare against, e.g. BillingCity or AnnualRevenue / 10. Used when "Expected Value Comes From" = "Record formula".
